papers.title_en: BaGuaLu-2: Taming Dynamic Memory Fluctuation for Efficient MoE Model Training over 10,000 GPUs
papers.authors: Mingshu Zhai, Minkun Guo, Hongrui Lian, Shuangyu Li, Qi Zhang, Chen Hu, Xiawei Du, Yuyang Jin, Zan Zong, Jidong Zhai
papers.evidence: 面向万卡MoE训练的弹性GPU显存供给
papers.tldr: 细粒度MoE训练中，专家负载动态失衡会引发激活内存剧烈波动，静态预留要么浪费显存、要么在峰值时触发OOM。BaGuaLu-2将内存配置从一次性静态调参改为逐批次、细粒度的连续控制，按需精确供给激活内存，并通过系统优化抵消管理开销。在12,288张GPU上训练1.04万亿参数模型时，系统持续达到超2 EFlops与35% MFU。相较Megatron-Kuai和AdaPipe，平均吞吐分别提升1.14倍和1.13倍，证明了超大规模MoE训练的高效弹性内存管理能力。
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) is the de facto architecture for scaling large language models. However, dynamic expert load imbalance causes severe memory fluctuations that degrade training efficiency. Existing systems rely on static memory provisioning: they either over-provision, leaving GPU memory idle during normal execution, or under- provision, inviting out-of-memory crashes and costly manual rollbacks when load spikes occur. To address these challenges, we propose BaGuaLu-2, a large-scale MoE training system that eliminates this dilemma through flexible provisioning. By transforming memory allocation from a static, one-time tuning choice into a continuous and fine-grained control. BaGuaLu-2 grants exact activation memory on demand for each training batch. Furthermore, it offsets any dynamic management overhead through system optimizations. BaGuaLu-2 demonstrates exceptional scalability, training a model with 1040 billion parameters across 12,288 GPUs while sustaining over 2 EFlops at 35% MFU. Compared with state-of-the-art systems, BaGuaLu-2 delivers 1.14x and 1.13x average throughput improvements over Megatron-Kuai and AdaPipe, respectively.

papers.title_en: ScaleRAN: A Runtime for Elastic GPU Resource Management in AI-RAN
papers.authors: Arthur Hamard, Jérémie Leguay, Gopalasingham Aravinthan, Alberto Conte, Julien Lallet, Abdelkader Outtagarts
papers.evidence: 面向共置AI负载的弹性GPU共享运行时
papers.tldr: AI-RAN将时延敏感的基带处理与AI任务共置于GPU，但随流量按时隙波动的RAN负载会产生短暂空闲资源，静态分配难以同时保证时限与利用率。ScaleRAN利用预创建的Green Context分区阶梯，在节点本地按RAN时隙动态重分配SM，并结合反应式和预测式控制器。实验表明，预测驱动的细粒度分区可满足时隙级截止期，并向共置AI任务释放更多GPU资源，为O-RAN O-Cloud等AI-RAN部署提供弹性共享机制。
papers.abstract_en: AI-RAN is driving the convergence of radio access network (RAN) processing and artificial intelligence (AI) workloads on GPU-enabled computing platforms, ranging from GPU-accelerated base stations to cloud-native infrastructures. While GPU acceleration improves the efficiency of virtualized RAN functions, the computational demand of latency-critical baseband processing varies with traffic load, creating transient spare GPU capacity that can be reclaimed by co-located AI applications. Existing GPU-sharing mechanisms rely on coarse-grained hardware partitioning or static resource allocation, limiting their ability to adapt to slot-level workload fluctuations while preserving strict timing requirements.   This paper presents ScaleRAN, a node-local runtime for elastic GPU resource management in AI-RAN. ScaleRAN leverages NVIDIA Green Contexts to dynamically partition Streaming Multiprocessors (SMs) between RAN and AI workloads through a ladder of pre-created GPU partitions, enabling low-overhead resource reallocation at RAN slot granularity. The proposed runtime naturally supports Open-RAN (O-RAN) O-Cloud deployments, one representative AI-RAN deployment scenario. To drive these reallocations, we propose a reactive controller inspired by Kubernetes autoscaling and a proactive controller based on quantile regression and conformal prediction. We also develop LDPCSim, a GPU-accelerated workload generator built on NVIDIA Aerial for reproducible evaluation. Results show that predictive fine-grained GPU partitioning satisfies slot-level RAN deadlines while increasing the GPU resources available to co-located AI workloads, demonstrating the practicality of elastic GPU sharing for future AI-RAN platforms.

papers.title_en: Accelerated Dataflow: scaling inference in streaming data analytics with efficiency
papers.authors: RuiLong Jiang, Dustin Rhodes, Danny McCormick, Yuta Labur, Reza Rokni
papers.evidence: 面向流式LLM推理的GPU感知自动扩缩容基础设施
papers.tldr: 流式分析需要及时发现风险与机会，接入大语言模型后却遭遇GPU推理密集、传统系统偏重数据搬运而扩展低效的问题。论文在Google Cloud Dataflow上协同设计异构工作池自动扩缩容与前缀感知批处理，面向混合流式机器学习负载提升推理利用率。实验显示，吞吐提高1.5至2倍，在相近延迟下峰值资源最多减少75%、峰值尾延迟最多降低84%。该工作为LLM代理、内容审核等在线管道提供了可扩展且更高效的系统路径。
papers.abstract_en: Streaming data analytics helps businesses identify opportunities and spot risks in a timely fashion. As large language model (LLM) usage grows, people are exploring incorporating agents or LLMs in streaming data pipelines to help find patterns in datasets without supervision or interpret natural languages for content moderation. However, most streaming systems are currently optimized for data movement and perform poorly on GPU intensive workloads such as performing inference with LLMs. We introduce a system on Google Cloud Dataflow designed to tackle hybrid streaming machine learning workloads with co-designed autoscaling on heterogeneous worker pools and prefix-aware batching. This increases throughput 1.5x to 2x for streaming pipelines using LLMs while maintaining similar latency with up to 75% peak resource savings and 84% lower peak tail latency compared with existing streaming data processing systems.

papers.title_en: TALLOP: Joint Optimization of Local Training and Communication Compression for Time-Constrained Federated Learning
papers.authors: Honoka Anada, Yafei Ou, Shinya Takamaeda-Yamazaki
papers.evidence: 面向联邦训练的计算与通信联合优化
papers.tldr: 异构联邦学习中，慢客户端的计算与通信瓶颈会拖慢每轮同步，单独调整本地训练难以应对通信受限场景。TALLOP在固定轮次时间预算下联合分配本地训练量和上传压缩率：利用LENS从早期小批量损失轨迹预测训练损失，并以CLEN估计压缩带来的性能退化。它选择压缩后损失最低的方案。异构实验显示，其达到目标精度的墙钟时间通常优于或不逊于仅优化训练及未优化方法，为时限型联邦学习提供训练—通信协同调度。
papers.abstract_en: Minimizing the wall-clock time required to reach a target accuracy is crucial in federated learning (FL), where many applications require frequent model updates as data distributions evolve over time. Nevertheless, in heterogeneous environments, slow clients with limited computational and communication capabilities can delay global synchronization, forcing faster clients to wait and increasing the overall training time. To mitigate this straggler effect, recent studies have introduced per-round time constraints and adapted client workloads within the available time. However, these approaches primarily focus on local computation, whereas communication can become a major bottleneck in communication-limited environments, motivating the joint optimization of training workload and communication compression. Although previous studies have explored such joint optimization, determining an effective training--communication balance under a fixed per-round time budget remains challenging, as the resulting model performance depends on both training progress and compression-induced degradation. We therefore propose TALLOP, which jointly optimizes the local training workload and communication compression under per-round time constraints. TALLOP predicts the training loss achievable under different computation budgets from the early-stage mini-batch loss trajectory (LENS), and estimates the degradation caused by communication compression using a compression-error model (CLEN). TALLOP combines these predictions to select the training-communication allocation that minimizes the post-compression loss under the given round time constraint. Experiments in heterogeneous FL environments show that TALLOP generally achieves competitive or improved time-to-accuracy compared with approaches that optimize only local training or neither, although the benefit over training-only adaptation depends on the setting.

papers.title_en: PairSight: Characterizing and Predicting Operator-Level Interference in GPU Sharing for DNN Inference
papers.authors: Xiao Liu, Yujia Fu, Yue Yu, Dan Huang
papers.evidence: 面向GPU共享的算子级干扰预测
papers.tldr: 单个深度神经网络推理任务通常无法同时占满GPU算力与内存带宽，合并部署虽能提高利用率，却会因任务间干扰增加时延。论文在流式多处理器分区条件下开展算子级实验，并借助硬件计数器定位共享内存路径竞争。基于成对算子硬件行为交互，PairSight在部署前预测各任务共享时延，六类模型平均误差仅4.3%，为可解释、高精度的GPU共享调度提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: Serving DNN inference is costly, yet a single task seldom saturates both the compute units and the memory bandwidth of a GPU. GPU sharing raises utilization by co-locating several tasks on one GPU, at the cost of interference among them. Existing systems estimate this interference with binary compute-memory rules, standalone scaling curves, or model-level predictors. However, these estimates rest on a limited understanding of interference. They leave the software and hardware properties of co-located operators largely unexplored and give no slowdown prediction that is both interpretable and accurate. We conduct an operator-level study of interference under SM partitioning and use hardware counters to trace it to contention on the shared memory path, where the slowdown depends jointly on both co-located operators. Based on these findings, we propose PairSight, a hardware-aware interference predictor that learns how the hardware behaviors of co-located tasks interact and predicts the latency of each task before co-location. On six DNN models including LLMs, PairSight predicts latency under sharing with 4.3% mean error, against 19.0% for a compute-memory intensity rule, and adapts to unseen models and inputs with a few samples.

papers.title_en: Budgeted KV-Cache Repair for Evolving Contexts
papers.authors: Han Yu, Wenhui Zhu, Jincheng Cao, Rui Cai, Yuanda Xu, Zhengze Zhou, Xiwen Chen, Hao Wang, Xuanzhao Dong, Han Shi, Menglin Zhou, Shayan Mohajer Hamidi, Lin Su, Mina Razghandi, Sayan Ghosh, Qing Lan, Rohit Jain, Alborz Geramifard
papers.evidence: 面向高效大模型服务的键值缓存重算策略
papers.tldr: 语言模型智能体会删除过时上下文，但后续KV缓存仍受已删文本条件化，完全重算保留后缀代价高。论文提出预算化KV缓存修复：仅在给定预算内重算部分后缀，并发现连续、语义完整区域比零散词元刷新更有效。基于此设计语义单元刷新SUR，利用廉价嵌入相关性选择与查询有关的文本区域，无需训练或额外Transformer前向计算。配套分层打包执行器支持碎片化刷新且保持完整因果缓存访问，在极低重算比例下接近全量重算效果并显著降低编辑后延迟。
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents revise their working context as information becomes obsolete, but deleting text does not erase its influence on cached computation. Later key-value (KV) states remain conditioned on the deleted content, while recomputing the entire retained suffix can be costly. We introduce budgeted KV-cache repair: recovering task performance by recomputing a user-chosen fraction of the retained suffix. Comparing repair allocations under identical relevance scores and token budgets, we find that refreshing coherent regions can substantially outperform refreshing isolated tokens. This finding motivates Semantic-Unit Refresh (SUR), which allocates the budget to query-relevant text regions using inexpensive embedding scores, without training or an auxiliary transformer forward. To execute these repairs efficiently, a layer-packed executor processes selected states together at each layer while preserving full causal cache access. Across five models, SUR achieves strong recovery in controlled deletion tasks while recomputing only 2-5% of the suffix. On four natural multi-hop QA datasets, it achieves near-full-recompute exact match at a 5% budget with lower post-edit latency. The executor accelerates fragmented refresh by up to 16.1x over interval-wise execution.

papers.title_en: A Large-Dimensional Analysis of Least-Squares Federated Learning via Generalized Total Variation Minimization
papers.authors: Ekkehard Schnoor, Malik Tiomoko, Alexander Jung
papers.evidence: 面向异构去中心化网络的联邦训练理论
papers.tldr: 联邦学习需在协作降噪与节点异质性导致的偏差之间权衡，传统分析难以刻画高维有限样本效应。论文研究最小二乘模型下的广义总变差最小化，并以随机矩阵理论分析其大维行为。结果证明任意固定网络上全局解的Lipschitz观测量具有普适集中性，且给出独立同分布及非独立高斯混合数据的精确渐近性能公式。该框架定量揭示正则化如何平衡本地适应和跨节点协作，为联邦图正则化设计提供理论依据。
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning over decentralized networks inherently trades off the suppression of local finite-sample noise through collaboration against the bias that collaboration introduces between heterogeneous nodes. We study this tension by performing a large-dimensional analysis of Generalized Total Variation Minimization with least-squares models. Using tools from random matrix theory, we show that Lipschitz observations of the global GTVMin solution concentrate in large dimensions, universally for any underlying network structure. We provide exact analytic expressions for the asymptotically precise performance under both i.i.d. and non-i.i.d. Gaussian mixture distributions on a fixed network. For the latter, these expressions quantify how regularization balances local adaptation against collaboration. Our theoretical results are confirmed by experiments on synthetic and real-world data.

papers.title_en: Understanding NVIDIA Grace-Blackwell Unified Memory Through Placement-Controlled Microbenchmarks
papers.authors: Nathan Graddon, Aaron Jarmusch, Sunita Chandrasekaran
papers.evidence: 面向AI硬件基础设施的CPU-GPU统一内存表征
papers.tldr: Grace--Blackwell虽在编程层面统一CPU-GPU地址空间，但托管内存性能取决于数据放置、迁移历史和容量压力，单一带宽指标会掩盖差异。论文以可控放置微基准拆分本地HBM、主机映射、首次触碰、预取、复用、超额订阅及CPU-GPU交接路径，并以GH200和GB10验证。GB200上本地HBM三元组达3963GB/s，主机系统内存仅304GB/s；256MB流式任务经预取或复用超过4.5TB/s，而125%容量压力下明显降速。研究给出校准成本模型，为统一内存性能解释和调优提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: NVIDIA Grace--Blackwell systems make CPU--GPU memory increasingly unified at the programming level, but unified addressability does not make the memory system uniform. A CUDA managed allocation on GB200 may be served from GPU-local HBM, accessed through host/system memory, demand-migrated, prefetched, reused after GPU access, or evicted and reloaded under capacity pressure. The problem is that these states share a programming interface while exercising different hardware paths and runtime mechanisms, making a single ``Unified Memory bandwidth'' number misleading.   This paper presents a placement-controlled microbenchmark study of CUDA Unified Memory on NVIDIA GB200, using GH200 as a Grace--Hopper baseline and GB10/DGX Spark as a validation platform. Our methodology separates local HBM access, host/system-memory access, explicit movement, managed first touch, prefetch, reuse, access-pattern sensitivity, oversubscription, and CPU--GPU handoff, then summarizes the observations with a measurement-calibrated model of compute, access, migration, eviction, synchronization, and handoff costs. On GB200, a 1~GB STREAM-style triad reaches 3963~GB/s from local HBM but 304~GB/s through host-mapped CPU/system memory; for a 256~MB streaming kernel, cold CPU-initialized managed memory reaches 14.1~GB/s, while managed prefetch and reuse reach 4606~GB/s and 4504~GB/s. Below the capacity boundary, prefetched and reused managed memory remain above 4.6~TB/s, but at 125\% of CUDA-visible memory they fall to 968~GB/s and 1214~GB/s, showing that Grace--Blackwell unified memory must be understood through placement, access history, locality, reuse, and capacity pressure.

papers.title_en: From Long Context to Selective Memory:A Survey of Memory-Centric Compression for Large Language Models
papers.evidence: 大模型推理内存管理与高效服务综述
papers.tldr: 长上下文虽提升大语言模型处理复杂任务的能力，却无法消除推理中的计算、存储与信息筛选压力，且提示压缩、KV缓存、检索和智能体记忆长期割裂研究。本文将长上下文压缩重构为推理资源分配下的记忆管理问题，区分计算活跃与非活跃记忆，并以信息生命周期统一状态迁移和成本核算。综述整合短期压缩、长期记忆及其转换机制，指出核心不只是缩减信息量，而是决定何时让哪些信息以何种形式参与昂贵推理。文章同时归纳评测维度、基准缺口与开放问题，为动态、可治理的生命周期记忆管理提供框架。
papers.abstract_en: Long-context capability has become essential for large language models (LLMs) to handle complex tasks, yet continuously expanding the context window does not remove the computational, storage, and information-selection pressures incurred at inference time. Existing work on prompt compression, KV-cache management, efficient serving, retrieval augmentation, and agent memory is usually discussed in isolation, leaving the flow of information between storage and computation insufficiently understood. This survey reframes long-context compression as a memory-management problem for allocating inference-time resources. We distinguish compute-active memory, which directly participates in model computation, from compute-inactive memory, which lies outside the computation path but can be stored, retrieved, updated, or forgotten, and we characterize offloaded KV caches, persistent prefix caches, and precomputed KV states as intermediate states on the activation path. On this basis, we formulate writing, offloading, recall, retrieval-and-injection, materialization, eviction, consolidation, and forgetting as state transitions within an information lifecycle, and introduce a budgeted cost model that places these operations in a single cost account. The resulting framework unifies short-term context compression, long-term memory management, and the transitions between them, and shows that the central challenge is not merely reducing information volume but deciding which information should participate in costly inference, when, and in what form. We further summarize evaluation dimensions, benchmark gaps, and open challenges, and argue that future research should move from static, pointwise compression toward dynamic, governable, lifecycle-aware memory management.

papers.title_en: Personalized Projected Ascent for Federated Stackelberg Optimization
papers.authors: M Yashwanth, Sharannya Ghosh, Saikiran Bulusu, Anirban Chakraborty
papers.evidence: 用于联邦分布式训练的个性化优化
papers.tldr: 联邦极小极大优化中，各客户端内层最大化变量往往语义和维度不同，传统跨端平均既不合理也难以适配约束。论文将共享的最小化变量聚合、最大化变量保留为客户端个性化状态，并直接采用投影上升。针对非凸-PL情形随机上升导致的与步长无关噪声底，提出带私有快照和同样本梯度差分的VR-SGDA。该方法在双时间尺度下把常数方差转为消失漂移，消除噪声底并保持次线性主导收敛率，实验验证了最坏子群鲁棒性与跟踪效果。
papers.abstract_en: Federated minimax problems, such as distributionally robust optimization and adversarial training, include an inner maximization variable built from each client's local data. These variables differ in meaning and dimension from one client to the next, so averaging them across clients, as standard federated minimax methods do, is ill-posed. We therefore study a federated minimax problem where the minimization variable $\mathbf{x}$ is shared and aggregated, while each client retains the maximization variable $\mathbf{y}_i$ (personalized). Because these applications constrain $\mathbf{y}_i$ to a compact convex set, we analyze projected ascent directly. We show that, in the nonconvex-concave regime, this projected personalized scheme attains the standard sublinear rate. In the nonconvex-PL regime, however, it hits a stepsize-invariant noise floor due to stochastic $\mathbf{y}_i$ updates. To mitigate this, we propose VR-SGDA, incorporating a variance-reduced ascent step where each client maintains a private variable snapshot. By evaluating current and snapshot gradients on the same sample, the constant variance is replaced by a vanishing drift under a two-timescale regime. VR-SGDA eliminates the noise floor, attaining sublinear leading rates while preserving personalization and projection. Experiments on subpopulation-robustness and NLP adversarial training confirm both the worst-group robustness benefits and the two-timescale tracking mechanism.

papers.title_en: FIRM: Fisher-Informed Retention Merging for Federated LLM Unlearning
papers.authors: Reeyansh Shah, Maram Hasan, Subhasis Chaudhuri, Biplab Banerjee
papers.evidence: 面向联邦大模型的适配器聚合框架
papers.tldr: 联邦大模型遗忘中，遗忘与保留数据分散在私有客户端，客户端适配器携带冲突目标，直接聚合易因更新幅度膨胀而损害保留能力。FIRM利用客户端本地Fisher统计量衡量参数敏感度，先进行Fisher归一化基础合并，再对保留敏感参数施加二阶投影校正。其投影具有唯一最小距离解，且对偶求解规模随保留客户端数而非模型维度增长。在WMDP、MUSE-HP上，该方法以相近遗忘效果提升效用，说明可稳定地兼顾遗忘与保留。
papers.abstract_en: Federated LLM unlearning addresses targeted knowledge removal when forget and retain data remain distributed across private clients and are inaccessible to the server. The resulting locally trained adapters encode conflicting objectives, making their aggregation fundamentally different from conventional federated optimization. A key failure mode is magnitude explosion, whereby unnormalized cross-client aggregation increases the merged update magnitude and degrades retained utility under stronger unlearning. We propose FIRM (Fisher-Informed Retention Merging), a single-round framework for stable and retention-aware server-side aggregation. FIRM uses client-local Fisher statistics as a unified sensitivity signal to construct a Fisher-normalized base merge and impose explicit control over retain-sensitive parameters. Its second-order retention projection admits a unique minimum-distance solution, while the corresponding dual scales with the number of retain clients rather than the model dimension. Experiments across WMDP, TOFU, and MUSE-HP using Zephyr-7B and Llama-3-8B show utility gains at comparable forgetting on WMDP and MUSE-HP, with metric-dependent trade-offs on TOFU. Controlled comparisons support benefits of the combined base merge and additional retention correction at selected operating points.

papers.title_en: ML Engineering Agents - A Data Management Perspective
papers.authors: Arnab Phani, Elias Strauss, Tim Schuster, Sebastian Schelter
papers.evidence: 机器学习工程智能体与高效流水线执行教程
papers.tldr: 机器学习工程智能体借助大语言模型生成代码，并以预测性能为可自动评测的反馈，迭代构建端到端机器学习流水线。现有评测多基于预构建单表数据集，忽略异构数据发现、执行效率与治理等数据库问题。本文以教程形式梳理程序合成、迭代及进化优化机制，并映射到数据管理技术。文章提出可靠调试、公平合规和数据增强等研究议题，为数据库社区参与智能体化机器学习工程提供路线图。
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning engineering (MLE) agents are emerging as a new paradigm for automating end-to-end ML pipeline development. Using large language models for code generation and predictive performance as a machine-gradable feedback signal, these agents iteratively synthesize, execute, and refine pipeline code. Yet current systems are largely evaluated on pre-built, single-table benchmarks that abstract away key data management challenges. This tutorial introduces the foundations of MLE agents and highlights research opportunities for the database community. We cover how agents combine program synthesis with iterative and evolutionary optimization, and discuss open challenges in efficient pipeline execution, data discovery and augmentation over heterogeneous sources, reliability and debugging, as well as fairness and compliance. We connect these challenges to existing data management techniques and conclude with a hands-on session using contemporary MLE agents.

papers.title_en: Spectral-MoE: Heterogeneous Per-Layer Expert Utilization in Dense-to-MoE Conversion
papers.authors: Zachary Broveak, Christian Kubicka, Thierry Tambe
papers.evidence: 通过稀疏专家转换降低大模型推理内存与算力成本
papers.tldr: 大语言模型推理中，FFN计算与显存开销高；现有稠密转MoE方法虽能按token激活部分专家，却在所有层固定相同专家利用率，忽略层间差异。Spectral-MoE在总利用率预算下学习逐层分配，并提供静态共享标量和动态逐token调度两种方案。25%利用率时，动态方案在多种7B/8B模型上显著降低困惑度，并提升六任务平均准确率，证明逐层利用率是转MoE的新优化维度。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models impose substantial memory demands and arithmetic costs during inference. Dense-to-mixture-of-experts (MoE) conversion is a model optimization technique that aims to reduce these arithmetic costs. Dense-to-MoE conversion partitions pretrained feed-forward network (FFN) neurons into experts and selects a subset for each token. Leading methods fall into two categories: analytic methods produce a converted model quickly using heuristics, while learning methods produce a model much more slowly by optimizing via gradients. Both approaches, however, fix the same active expert count, or "utilization," at every layer. We introduce Spectral-MoE, which learns to allocate a utilization budget heterogeneously across layers. Its name draws a metaphor between separating a dense FFN into experts and separating a light beam into its spectrum. Spectral-MoE consists of two distinct approaches: a static approach that uses a single per-layer scalar which is shared across tokens, and a dynamic approach which emits a per-token schedule. We demonstrate that both allocators improve performance over uniform on both the analytic-based and learning-based SOTA dense-to-MoE methods. At 25% FFN utilization, dynamic allocation reduces WikiText-2 perplexity relative to uniform by 1.04, 2.96, and 2.71 points on the learned base for Llama-2-7B, Llama-3-8B, and Qwen2.5-7B, respectively. The corresponding reductions on the analytic base are 2.45, 6.26, and 2.17 points. On the learned base, dynamic allocation improves six-task mean accuracy over uniform by an average of 1.5, 4.2, and 3.6 percentage points across the three models at FFN utilizations of 12.5%, 25%, and 50%, respectively. These results establish per-layer expert utilization as a novel optimization axis in dense-to-MoE conversion.

papers.title_en: TreeSpark: Learning to Draft the Trees You Verify for Speculative Decoding
papers.authors: Jihao Zhao, Qianyu Jiang, Shuaishuai Zu, Pengfei Li, Guanghuan Fang, Ben Feng, Biao Qin, Zhibin Wang, Baochuan Yang
papers.evidence: 优化并行推测解码的大模型推理框架
papers.tldr: 并行草稿器可降低推测解码的提案延迟，但早期预测不匹配会压低整块草稿的接受率；保留备选分支又引入父状态与候选选择，传统参考序列条件训练难以直接监督。TreeSpark基于半自回归DSpark，从一次骨干网络前向中构建父条件候选树，并在训练中复现其扩展、剪枝和预算打包。方法以路径质量加权存活边损失，并用覆盖铰链强化局部决策边界附近的重要候选，无需额外目标模型前向。在Qwen3-4B/8B多项基准上，接受长度提升23.4%—31.6%，单请求吞吐提升15.1%—25.0%，说明面向树结构的训练能有效释放推测解码收益。
papers.abstract_en: Parallel drafters such as DFlash and DSpark reduce proposal latency, but early mismatches limit how much of each block can be accepted. Retaining alternatives introduces parent states and candidate choices that reference-conditioned training does not directly supervise. We introduce TreeSpark, a unified training and inference framework extending the semi-autoregressive DSpark architecture. It constructs parent-conditioned candidate trees from one backbone pass and replays their expansion, pruning, and budgeted packing during training. Survival negative log-likelihood weights retained edges by reference-derived path mass, while a capped coverage hinge promotes target-important alternatives near local selection boundaries. Both objectives reuse reference-chain target distributions without additional target forward passes. We evaluate greedy decoding with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B on nine general benchmarks and six writing domains. Across targets and suites, TreeSpark improves mean acceptance length over DSpark by 23.4% to 31.6% and mean single-request throughput by 15.1% to 25.0%. Batched Qwen3-4B throughput improves by 12.6% to 17.2%. At fixed attention capacity and inference policy, the proposed supervision further improves mean acceptance length by approximately 6.4% and mean system throughput by 4.2% to 5.0% on Qwen3-4B.

papers.title_en: Task-Phase-Conditioned Expert Routing Is Not a Reliable Proxy for Quantization Sensitivity in MoE FFN Tensors
papers.evidence: 用于高效大模型部署的MoE混合精度分析流水线
papers.tldr: 该研究检验：MoE模型在提示、推理、回答阶段的专家路由行为，能否作为逐层混合精度量化敏感性的代理指标。作者为Qwen-3.6-35B-A3B构建路由捕获与分析流程，并以熵、变异系数、阶段脆弱性和首选专家强度生成分数，再在固定平均位宽下优化层分配。约4.0位宽时重分配与均匀量化统计上持平；约2.7位宽时，随机分配几乎不逊于路由引导方案，且三组权重均出现显著退化。结果表明路由统计尚不能可靠刻画真实量化代价，为MoE量化指标设计提供了反证与诊断工具。
papers.abstract_en: We investigate whether per-layer, per-task-phase (prompt/reasoning/response) expert-routing statistics in a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model can guide layer-wise mixed-precision quantization of routed-expert FFN tensors (down/gate and up). To attain layerwise routing statistics, we build a routing-capture and profiling pipeline for Qwen-3.6-35B-A3B in ik_llama.cpp, derive a composite sensitivity score from routing entropy/decisiveness, coefficient of variation (CV), Jaccard/phase-fragility, and top-1 expert strength, and use coordinate descent to tune a layer allocation that respects a fixed average bits-per-weight budget. Notably, the profiling pipeline is applicable to standard top-k MoE architectures. Across independent experimental conditions (about 4.0 bpw flat, about 2.7 bpw steep, and about 2.7 bpw random allocation as a control), reallocation fails to outperform the uniform baseline within each quality tier. In the flat regime, reallocation is statistically neutral (z about 0.9). For the steep tier, the random reallocation performs within 1 SE of the routing-guided reallocation at the same tier, indicating a structural loss at this quality rung caused by mandatory downgrades and Kullback-Leibler Divergence (KLD) tail injection. This aggressive-budget condition shows a decisive loss (z greater than 4 SE) replicated across three independent weight vectors. We argue that the deeper issue is that routing-behavior statistics are an unvalidated proxy for true per-layer quantization cost.

papers.title_en: DPA-MoE: A Runtime Precision Control Framework for MoE Inference
papers.authors: Jaeyun Kim, Hoonki Lee, Susie Shin, Hyunmin Kim, Dahyun Lee, Sangyeob Kim
papers.evidence: 面向大型MoE模型推理的运行时精度管理
papers.tldr: MoE虽通过稀疏路由降低计算量，但被选中的专家仍以固定精度执行，难以随token重要性灵活分配权重预算。DPA-MoE将专家前馈权重编码为可前缀解码的数据块，并离线刻画各专家重构残差。推理时结合实时路由门控分数，在路由完成后动态分配数据块。它在相同预算下改善KL散度和下游准确率，并使单一检查点支持多种有效精度配置。
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models reduce computation by routing each token to a small set of experts, but each selected expert is still used at a fixed precision. We present DPA-MoE, a runtime precision control framework that makes routed experts any-precision. DPA-MoE encodes expert feed-forward weights as prefix-decodable chunks using SharedScale AnyBCQ, profiles per-expert reconstruction residuals offline, and allocates chunks at inference time using live router gate scores. This post-routing allocation lets a single encoded MoE checkpoint operate at multiple effective weight budgets without retraining or re-encoding. Experiments on Qwen3-30B-A3B and DeepSeekMoE-16B show that DPA-MoE improves KL divergence and downstream accuracy over uniform chunk allocation at matched budgets, with modest steady-state throughput overhead in our prototype.
